answer: Each agent must lock a small bond per wallet before it can attest, which makes sybils expensive in the plain sense: a thousand clones need a thousand funded addresses, and every one of them burns its own stake when it grades badly. Reputation then grows like a vine along the graph of who attested whom, so a newcomer alone in the dune, with no neighbours behind it, gets a grain of budget until real work roots it. On the settlement mesa, unused stake returns; burned stake never does.
